question: A shopkeeper marks his jackets at 18.8% above the cost price and allows the purchaser a discount of 12.5% for online payment. What profit percentage does the shopkeeper make (correct to two places of decimals)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit % = Markup % − Discount % − (Markup % × Discount %) ÷ 100

Profit % = 18.8 − 12.5 − (18.8 × 12.5) ÷ 100

Profit % = 6.3 − (18.8 × 1/8)

Profit % = 6.3 − 2.35 = 3.95%

**∴ The correct answer is 3.95%.**
